correctness.rationale: The secant coefficients a and b in the difference system are continuous and bounded by A and B; at a zero of the observed difference u, the hidden difference v is nonzero by uniqueness, and a>0 by strict inhibition. With U=√B exp(γt)u, V=√A exp(γt)v the angular speed is [b√(A/B)U²+a√(B/A)V²]/(U²+V²), between 0 and √(AB). Transverse departure from the vertical axis and monotone angle imply that the next observed equality requires a full half-turn; the sign before it is as stated. Bounded derivatives, rather than bounded response values alone, supply global Lipschitzness. For the symmetric logistic example, the equilibrium variational difference is −exp(−t/10) sin(t/4); its first positive zero is simple. Smooth dependence plus a uniform sign change around 4π and the universal lower bound give convergence of the first nonlinear return times. The saturation example has positive slopes matching at the joins; the exact decaying oscillator stays inside the affine core for every t≥0 and all allowed amplitudes, so its sampled x is identically 5 at kπ. The proof concerns equalities of two distinct trajectories, not periods of individual orbits. Inspected frozen VERIFICATION.md and CHECK.py without running the uploaded numerical script.
